evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and possession of capability as the appealed-to good, situating autonomy against dependence.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Declaring the perspective — not the substrate — as the retained asset elevates self-origination and personal standing over commodity tools.
Naming a thesis of individually-owned intelligence explicitly appeals to self-origination as the organizing value, though the signal is thinner than the first two segments.
